line:little-mill:2: Pip gives half to a kind man.
line:little-mill:3: The man gives Pip a magic mill.
line:little-mill:5: Whirr, whirr! Salt spills in the sea.
line:little-mill:6: Pip says, “Rest!” and the sea sparkles.
complete:little-mill: Pip shared, listened, and helped the sea.
line:pink-flowers:1: Fia loves her pot of pinks.
line:pink-flowers:2: She walks to get fresh water.
line:pink-flowers:3: The Wood Queen gives her a gold cup.
line:pink-flowers:4: A silly cabbage says, “Look by the bed!”
line:pink-flowers:5: Fia finds the pinks and shares the water.
line:pink-flowers:6: Pop, pop, pop! The pinks wake and bloom.
complete:pink-flowers: Fia cared for a small thing, and it grew.
line:glass-hill:1: Ash keeps watch by the hay.
line:glass-hill:2: Boom! A bright copper horse comes near.
line:glass-hill:3: Then silver and gold horses come.
line:glass-hill:4: Ash rides up the glass hill.
line:glass-hill:5: Three gold apples shine at the top.
line:glass-hill:6: Ash brings them home to share.
complete:glass-hill: Ash stayed calm, climbed high, and shared.
